name: Reported feedback regression checks v1
provenance: Assistant-labeled development checks based on reported errors and related factual/praise examples. Used for model selection, never an independent accuracy benchmark.
labeling_policy: Explicit criticism is negative, explicit praise is positive, and factual statements without expressed opinion are neutral.

examples.text: The survey is far too long and the questions are confusing.
examples.label: negative
examples.note: Explicit complaints about length and confusing questions.

examples.label: neutral
examples.note: A count of questions does not express dissatisfaction.

examples.text: The survey is clear and easy to complete.
examples.label: positive
examples.note: Explicit praise for clarity and ease.

examples.label: neutral
examples.note: No explicit positive or negative opinion.

examples.text: I have not used the service yet.
examples.label: neutral
examples.note: Not having used the service is factual, not a complaint.

examples.text: My resume upload keeps failing. This is frustrating.
examples.label: negative
